name: Kasumi Rikka
source:
Element: Carbon
Rank: 純参位
Hobby/Skill: Drawing/Japanese traditional food

A sensitive "diamond in the rough" with a lot of potential, but has low self-esteem and is almost crushed by the expectations of those around him. 
He loves to draw and wanted to learn more about the world, so he decided to become a Shikenkan.
